metadata.description: Free Claude skills from the Bottomless catalog: fixed rules, a limits section, no invented numbers.

plugins.name: error-oracle
plugins.description: Paste an error message. Get back which line is to blame and what to do next.

plugins.name: skill-checker
plugins.description: You paste a SKILL.md. You get back whether you should install it, before an agent does.

plugins.name: migration-checker
plugins.description: You paste your migration. You get back what it locks, for how long, and how to get back if it goes wrong.

plugins.name: pipeline-diagnosis
plugins.description: You paste your data pipeline's error message. You get back which stage is at fault and what to check next.

plugins.name: query-smith
plugins.description: Paste your table schema and ask in plain English. Get the matching SQL query.

plugins.name: cve-triage
plugins.description: You paste a CVE report and your stack. You get back whether it affects you — in one sentence, not security jargon.
